evidence_items.claim: SMBC is NOT a FINOS member - not listed on FINOS members page
evidence_items.excerpt: SMBC, Sumitomo Mitsui, SMFG, or any SMBC subsidiary is not listed among FINOS members.

evidence_items.claim: SMBC has NO current ISDA Board member (unlike Nomura, MUFG, Mizuho)
evidence_items.excerpt: No current ISDA board members are directly affiliated with SMBC, Sumitomo Mitsui, or SMFG.

evidence_items.claim: SMBC Capital Markets is CFTC registered swap dealer with $8.9B assets (Dec 2024)
evidence_items.excerpt: SMBC Capital Markets, Inc. engages in swap dealing activities sufficient to require registration with the CFTC as a 'swap dealer'. Total assets of $8.9B.

evidence_items.claim: SMBC is a shareholder in Progmat digital securities platform (~6.5% stake)
evidence_items.excerpt: Other shareholders include SMBC, Mizuho, and Sumitomo Mitsui Trust—which each now own just under 6.5%.

evidence_items.claim: SMBC uses ISDA Master Agreements for derivatives but no governance role identified
evidence_items.excerpt: SMBC BI uses ISDA Credit Support Annex terms for collateral against certain derivative transactions.
